key_insight: Pre-distributing entangled qubit pairs can reduce communication delays when executing quantum circuits across networked quantum devices.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets distributed quantum execution latency and the risk of logical-qubit decoherence while waiting for remote-gate resources.
method: Select entanglement pairs to pre-distribute under a budget, optionally using a training-circuit distribution.
Optimize qubit-to-memory allocation to minimize expected execution time with the available entanglement.
Generate additional required entanglement pairs concurrently and execute circuit gates.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluate their methods on a broad range of benchmark circuits, but the abstract reports no quantitative speedups.
watch_item: Practical benefits depend on maintaining usable pre-distributed entanglement until it is needed.
paper_title: Distributing Quantum Circuits Using Pre-Distributed Entanglement Pairs over Quantum Networks
